evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep asks 'Do you have about ten minutes to run through this with me?' but never delivers the time-boxed framing + dependable quote promise + wait for yes. No recognizable version of the quid pro quo structure.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep skips straight to probing: 'do you have any just top of mind questions or concerns that I can kind of answer right off the top' is a throwaway variant, not the real agenda frame. Probing begins immediately after.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Comprehensive coverage: property type (1BR apartment), floor/stories (3rd floor, destination 2nd floor), number of rooms (implied 1 bed + living), walking distance (two sets of stairs, distances clarified), additional rooms (none), special considerations (dog kennels, health issues, organized staging), additional stops (none). All seven items or near-equivalent covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked and answered: 'approximately how many boxes would you say you'll have?' Customer responds with detail about 12 small boxes, textbooks, U-Haul boxes. Rep estimates $15–20 total boxes.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Never asked. No mention of 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: No anchor given. Rep never provides a typical range for a 1BR apartment move. Estimate is not stated on the call at all — no dollar amount, no labor hours, no service tier. Rep says 'I'm gonna put that little estimate' but no actual quote is delivered to the customer.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Rep mentions 'on time guarantee' and '$2,000' damage coverage but does not deliver fee transparency upfront (no trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials disclosure) and does not frame the 2.5-hour minimum or 15-minute-increments commitment. Only the two promises are partially covered, not the pricing discipline framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any version of it. No pricing objection-handling or silence discipline in Section 4.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Partial. Rep states 'on time guarantee cause we wanna make sure that we arrive on time money is automatically deducted. If we're not on time.' This covers the discount terms conceptually but is vague on the mechanics (how much, what counts as late, immediate start of discount). Not fully transparent.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial. Rep says 'the Noor damage coverage that does cover-up to $2,000 for any kind of incidentals.' This states the $2,000 amount but omits the critical no-deductible/no-fine-print framing and does not explicitly confirm it's built into the rate, not an add-on. Incomplete as delivered.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. Rep pivots to closing remarks ('I wouldn't change anything on the estimate, the time range is it looks really good. So if you do need anything please feel free to reach out') without confirming the customer's comfort with the Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep does not ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine version. Rep jumps to closing without a final concerns check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. Never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any recognizable version. Call ends with 'Alright, well you enjoy the rest of your day and we will see you very soon' — an assumption of booking with no explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False. No mention of rate lock or no-deposit terms.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. No date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses, or crew notes confirmed. Customer volunteers to call 'the week before' to clarify stairwell details, but rep does not lock in booking details.

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered comprehensive logistics details (stairs, parking, special items, dog kennels, customer health status) and created detailed notes for the crew, setting up a smooth move day despite the apartment's access complexity.
coaching_note: You must deliver an explicit pricing quote with a dollar range and clear fee transparency (trip fee, materials, minimums) before moving to the Two Promises — right now customers leave the call with no idea what the move costs, and you never ask for the business.
